description: The plot illustrates the relationship between sample token count and shared experts for two experts across different tasks. The x-axis is labeled “Sample Token Count” and is a logarithmic scale, ranging from 2<sup>9</sup> to 2<sup>20</sup>, with tick labels at intervals of 2<sup>2</sup>. The y-axis is labeled “Shared Experts for Two Experts” and is a linear scale, ranging from 2.0 to 6.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5.  A blue line, representing “Intent”, begins at approximately 5.6 at 2<sup>9</sup> and declines to approximately 5.1 at 2<sup>11</sup>, then rises to approximately 5.7 at 2<sup>20</sup>. An orange line, representing “Summary”, starts at approximately 3.3 at 2<sup>9</sup> and increases to approximately 5.8 at 2<sup>20</sup>. A yellow line, representing “Law”, begins at approximately 4.5 at 2<sup>9</sup> and increases to approximately 5.8 at 2<sup>20</sup>. A purple line, representing “Translation”, starts at approximately 5.2 at 2<sup>9</sup> and declines to approximately 4.6 at 2<sup>12</sup>, then rises to approximately 5.6 at 2<sup>20</sup>. A green line, representing “Math”, begins at approximately 4.9 at 2<sup>9</sup> and increases to approximately 5.7 at 2<sup>20</sup>.
